What You'll Get

Buy once, use multiple times

You pay once. After that you get unlimited edits: change your page and update your live page as many times as you want, and nothing extra to pay. Every update goes to the same shareable link, so whatever you made live last is what your link shows. Anyone who already has the link keeps seeing your newest version.

Mobile responsive

Built to look clean and feel easy to open on phones, where most people will actually view it.

Privacy first, password protected

Lock your live page behind a password so only the people you share it with can open the link.

Add your own domain

Already own a domain? Point it at your page in a few clicks and share it on your own web address instead of ours. Optional, and only if you want it.

Professionally designed and animated. Not a cheap Canva template you have seen a hundred times.
